user.title: Add MikroTik tag
user.description: Enter the tag's Bluetooth MAC address and a friendly name. The tag must be in range and broadcasting unencrypted MikroTik v1 telemetry.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up MikroTik tag
bluetooth_confirm.description: Set up the tag at {address}. Choose a friendly name.

error.invalid_address: Enter a MAC address such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.no_scanner: No Bluetooth scanner is available. Configure Bluetooth or a Bluetooth proxy first.
error.not_found: No MikroTik telemetry was received. Move the tag into range and enable periodic unencrypted MikroTik-format advertisements.
error.unsupported_packet: This device is not broadcasting supported MikroTik v1 telemetry.
error.encrypted: Encrypted telemetry is not supported. Disable packet encryption in MikroTik Beacon Manager.

abort.unsupported_packet: This is not a supported MikroTik v1 telemetry packet.
abort.encrypted: Encrypted telemetry is not supported. Disable packet encryption in MikroTik Beacon Manager before adding this tag.
